what.text: This page follows refugees from Moldova living in Russia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 60 Moldovan refugees in Russia, 1.0% of all refugees from Moldova.
Germany hosts the most Moldovan refugees, followed by the United States, France and Romania.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Moldova: over Dniestr territory with the PMR in 1992.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 and 1997.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at its highest figure, 5132 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Russia.
These are year-end totals for Russia only, reported to UNHCR.
